page_title: MAL 3-1 PAL | Mallorca v Las Palmas 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Scott McKenna (Las Palmas) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+5' Toni Lato (Mallorca) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
90+3' The referee signals a substitution. Valery is brought on as a substitute for Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca).
90+3' Great teamplay by Mallorca as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefan Bajcetic departs the field of play to be replaced by Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas).
86' Here comes a substitution. Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Vedat Muriqi.
86' Here comes a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez is given a rest as he is replaced by Toni Lato (Mallorca).
84' The foul by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was seen by Miguel Ortiz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
84' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' A yellow card for bad language! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.

82' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a daisy-cutter shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper produces an amazing acrobatic dive to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and hits the post.
81' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

80' A great solo run by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Jasper Cillessen. The referee blows his whistle, Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
80' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
80' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
79' Dominik Greif (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.
78' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Dominik Greif (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
76' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
76' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is caught offside!
74' The linesman raises his flag. Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is adjudged offside.
73' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' Here is a change. Robert Navarro is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
72' It is time for a substitution. Jose Campana is on for Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas).
71' Diego Martinez decides to make a substitution. Viti will be replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
71' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
71' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Cyle Larin (Mallorca) replaces Takuma Asano.
71' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
67' A quickly taken corner by Las Palmas.
67' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
67' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca). Miguel Ortiz saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Las Palmas will take a free kick near the side line.
65' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

62' 3 - 1 It's in! Viti spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 3:1.
60' The attendance for today's match is 18475.
57' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
55' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
54' Vedat Muriqi picks out Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar.
50' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
49' The game is interrupted. Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
48' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
47' Las Palmas fail to score from a corner as Dominik Greif (Mallorca) leaps to collect the ball.
46' Half-time substitution. Diego Martinez decided to make a change. Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is replaced by Andy Pelmard.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Viti (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Miguel Ortiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is adjudged offside.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Las Palmas is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
40' We are about to witness a substitution. Benito Ramirez is replacing Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
39' A brilliant cross into the box finds Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
35' 3 - 0 Goal! Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
33' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
28' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Johan Mojica laid the ball off to Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
28' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) commits a foul and Miguel Ortiz immediately signals a free kick.
25' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
25' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.
24' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
19' The free kick is taken by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas), but ball is cleared.
19' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
18' Mallorca decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
18' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul after Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) hacks down one of his opponents.
14' The free kick from long range, taken by Las Palmas, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' Las Palmas seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' 1 - 0 Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the left post.

6' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Miguel Ortiz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
3' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Dominik Greif easily makes the save.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Mallorca will kick the game off.
Miguel Ortiz will officiate today.
